## Validation

- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] release validation, if task contracts changed
- [ ] `npm run build`, if the public site changed

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] No PHI, credentials, private labels, or unlicensed material
- [ ] Runtime task view does not expose graders or gold
- [ ] Safety/escalation behavior is explicit
- [ ] Results and limitations are reported without clinical overclaiming
